nivolumab.source_basis: Current EMA Opdivo product information and NCCP 00483/00484 v13a. Shared nivolumab profile; not a regimen-specific frequency estimate. Combination risks require the complete selected regimen discussion.

risks.label: Immune inflammation in healthy organs
risks.detail: Lungs, bowel, liver, kidneys, glands, skin, heart, muscles, nerves and eyes can be affected. Some reactions are severe or fatal and need steroids, specialist treatment or hospital care. Report symptoms promptly.

risks.label: Delayed or lasting immune effects
risks.detail: Reactions can arise during treatment or after stopping; monitor for at least five months after the last dose. Hormone replacement may be long term or permanent. Carry the immune alert card.

risks.label: Infusion or injection reactions
risks.detail: Report breathlessness, swelling, rash, tight chest or dizziness immediately. IV and SC are distinct formulations and doses; the team confirms which applies. SC is not approved for classical Hodgkin lymphoma in the audited NCCP sources.

risks.label: Pregnancy prevention and breastfeeding
risks.detail: Use effective contraception during treatment and for at least five months after the final dose. Discuss fertility, pregnancy and breastfeeding; combination medicines may require longer or stricter precautions.

rare_immune_events.label: Myocarditis and muscle/nerve overlap
rare_immune_events.detail: Heart inflammation can overlap with myositis and myasthenia gravis and can be fatal; chest pain, palpitations, weakness or swallowing/breathing difficulty needs urgent assessment.

rare_immune_events.label: Serious neurological inflammation
rare_immune_events.detail: Guillain–Barré syndrome, neuropathy, myasthenic syndromes, meningitis, encephalitis or myelitis can cause severe weakness, confusion, seizures or respiratory problems.

rare_immune_events.label: Severe skin reactions
rare_immune_events.detail: Blistering or peeling skin, mucosal sores or spreading rash may indicate SJS/TEN and require immediate assessment.

rare_immune_events.label: Eye inflammation
rare_immune_events.detail: Eye pain, redness or visual change needs urgent review.

rare_immune_events.label: Pancreatitis
rare_immune_events.detail: Persistent severe abdominal pain or vomiting needs assessment.
